    Emrys¶

    "What the fuck is this pulse rifle doing here." — Emrys, age 6, past-life memory breaking through

    Emrys is one of the two protagonists of Ge'or, born in 597 AGD in the Grimmel Republic. He is the first son of a Northaxeland mother from an adventurer family. He carries the black agent in his blood, the Hope Goddess's mission in his soul, and a recognition of things no child should recognize.

    Before this life, he was a man named Mikhail on dystopian Old Earth. See: Emrys — Life Before Ge'or

    Early Life¶

    He grows up with the instincts of a hunter — watchful, patient, quick to act. His mother's adventurer blood runs true. His family is unconventional: his father Marco has two wives — his Northaxeland mother Annika and a catmen second wife, Camillia. A catmen catgirl, Narin, also lives with them, working as a cook and cleaner, treated as part of the family.

    But the most important person in his household is his twin sister, Ichi. Born moments after him, sharing the same black agent, the same magical potential, and a past that stretches back three million years. She was the robot who took a bullet for him. Now she is his sister. Neither of them remembered at first — but the memories are surfacing.

    By age six, he is already following people who interest him, tracking patterns, asking questions others dismiss.

    The Pulse Rifle Recognition¶

    At age six, Emrys encounters Amelia — a girl one year his junior, carrying a weapon she calls a lightning bow. Emrys looks at it and says:

    "What the fuck is this pulse rifle doing here."

    He does not know why he knows those words. He does not know what a pulse rifle is. But something in him — something older than his body, older than Ge'or, older than the Great Divergence — recognizes the weapon instantly.

    This is the first crack in the wall between his infant consciousness and his past-life memory.

    The Ravine¶

    Emrys follows Amelia for three months, obsessed with the weapon. When she falls into a ravine and ten Goblins surround her, he kills them all with a lightning spell. He is six years old. The magical potential sleeping in his blood — top 0.001% of all living beings — has already begun to wake.

    Amelia's mother adores him after this. He becomes a fixture in their home.

    The Hope Goddess Mission¶

    Before birth, Emrys received the same vision as Lucien: the Hope Goddess, the war in the hope realm, the mission to destroy the hivemind in the Fortress Planet. He remembers none of it consciously — but the weight is there. The pulse rifle recognition is proof.

    But the mission goes deeper than the vision. In his previous life, Emrys was a rebel on Old Earth who helped capture an AGI ship, was accidentally cryogenized in a Sterman Pod, and injected with an experimental strain of the black agent. He did not ask to be a hero. He was just a man who refused to comply.

    He and Lucien — Arkady in that life — were friends before they were protagonists. They have been fighting together for three million years. They just don't remember it yet.

    Connections¶

    • Co-protagonist: Lucien (Arkady in the previous life)
    • Essential ally: Amelia — keeper of the Pulse Rifle
    • Previous life: Emrys — Life Before Ge'or — Mikhail, rebel, Sterman Pod occupant
    • Companion: Ichi — robot companion on Earth, cartridge preserved in his head port
    • Vision: Hope Goddess
    • Mission: Destroy the hivemind in Fortress Planet
    • The Claim: The Black Agent Hivemind can reach through his blood — discovered very late (see The Twinning)
    • Born: 597 AGD, Grimmel Republic
    • Father: Marco Eisenheart — Grimmel, adventurer stock
    • Mother: Annika Eisenheart — Northaxeland adventurer
    • Power: Top 0.001% magical potential
    • Family: Camillia Eisenheart (catmen second wife), Narin Eisenheart (catgirl servant, raised as family)
    • Status: Child — the story begins with a pulse rifle and a question
